newsitem.title: USA: API data spur jet prices sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: API data spur jet prices sharply higher.

text.p: U.S. cash jet fuel prices enjoyed sharp gains late Tuesday, traders said, thanks to bullish API data showing a scant 235,000-barrel distillate build for the prior week.
Prices rose as October heating oil futures jumped 0.60 cent in after-hours ACCESS trade, added to a 0.30-cent gain in earlier NYMEX activity.

New York aviation-quality 54-grade fuel was offered at 4.50 cents above October futures, steady with Monday differentials, with Gulf Coast 54-grade diffs slipping about 0.30 cent to 0.80 cent over the print, players said.
